title: Game Settings
html:
When creating a single player game or a private lobby, game settings can be changed. This includes the selected map, bot difficulty, switching between FFA and Teams mode and additional game options.

Bot Difficulty

There are 4 difficulties to select from:

  • Relaxed
  • Balanced
  • Intense
  • Impossible

For more information on the difficulties, see difficulty.

Game Mode

There are 2 game modes to choose from:

  • Free for All (FFA)
  • Teams

Teams mode is split into several sub-modes:

  • 2-7 teams
  • Duos (Teams of 2)
  • Trios (Teams of 3)
  • Squads (Teams of 4)
  • Humans Vs Nations

Additional Options

Different buildings/units can be toggled:

  • City
  • Defense Post
  • Port
  • Warship
  • Missile Silo
  • SAM Launcher
  • Atom Bomb
  • Hydrogen Bomb
  • MIRV

The bot count can be set in a range from 0 to 400 and nations can be toggled.

Other options can be toggled:

  • Instant Build
  • Random Spawn
  • Infinite Gold
  • Infinite Troops
  • Compact Map
  • Anonymous Names (replaces player names with memorable animal names, as of Update 33.0)

The game length can be set in minutes from this menu. A custom alliance duration can also be configured (as of Update 33.0).
